The *Hetugocchaka, Kusalattika* (Patthana 3.2) is a component text of the *Paṭṭhāna*, the seventh book of the Theravāda Abhidhamma Piṭaka [Catalog]. Structurally, it integrates the *hetugocchaka* (the cluster of dyads relating to roots or causal conditions) with the *kusalattika* (the foundational triad of wholesome, unwholesome, and indeterminate dhammas), applying conditional relations across this combined matrix.
